Corporate.title: Corporate Domain Instructions
Corporate.highlight: Video is MANDATORY + Choose any ONE task
rules: The Self-Introduction Video is mandatory(30s – 1 min).
In addition to the video, you MUST complete any ONE of the assigned domain tasks.
Upload all deliverables (video, report, spreadsheet, or pitch deck) to Google Drive.
Ensure Drive share settings are set to 'Anyone with the link can view' before submitting.
Corporate.note: Submissions missing the self-introduction video will not be evaluated.

Technical.title: Technical Domain Instructions
rules: Select and complete any ONE task from the available tracks (e.g., WebDev, AI/ML).
Host your source code on a public GitHub repository with a descriptive README.
Include pinned dependency versions and seed configs where applicable.
Provide live demo / deployment links and screen recordings if requested in the task guidelines.
Technical.note: Repositories must remain public until evaluation is complete.

Creatives.title: Creatives Domain Instructions
rules: Select and complete any ONE task from the GFX / UI/UX track.
Work must be executed in Figma following the official GCSRM branding guidelines.
Submit the direct Figma file link with view permissions enabled.
List all third-party plugins, asset packs, and design references used in the submission.
Creatives.note: Figma files must have public view permissions enabled.
